**Description**
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.
  
  
Do you want to work on a product that can do the following?:
  
  
Access petabytes of data in single-digit milliseconds
  
  
Replicate tables across continents
  
  
Stream terabytes of data updates per hour continuously
  
  
Back up hundreds of terabytes of data in seconds
  
  
Encrypt petabytes of data with no performance degradation
  
  
Amazon DynamoDB is a NoSQL database service that does all this and more. DynamoDB is a key-value and document database that delivers single-digit-millisecond performance at any scale. DynamoDB can store petabytes of customer data and handle peaks of more than 20 million requests per second.
  
  
As a fast growing service at the core of the AWS Cloud, our business and engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses, such as Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin, as well as enterprises, such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One, depend on the scale and performance of DynamoDB to support their mission-critical workloads.
  
  
DynamoDB is one of the largest distributed database systems in the world, and we continue to believe it is Day 1 for the DynamoDB business. We are constantly improving and adding new capabilities to DynamoDB, and we are looking for a deeply technical, team-first software development engineer to push DynamoDB even further.
  
  
DynamoDB engineers are constantly challenged to think of unique and innovative solutions. The quality bar is high. As an engineer here, you will work on the hardest engineering problems in distributed systems at a massive scale and on multiple dimensions. You will exercise your intellectual curiosity, work with motivated teams of sharp individuals, and get insightful guidance from senior and principal engineers.
  
  
This is a hands-on position in which you will own everything from end to end: requirements gathering, designs, design reviews, implementations, code reviews, incremental feature launches, operations, mentoring, and the driving of continuous improvement.

Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

# Junior IoT, AI Vision & Hardware Developer

### Entry-Level | AI Xccelerate (AIX)

\*\*Location:\*\* [Add location / on-site or hybrid]

\*\*Employment type:\*\* [Full-time / Internship / Contract]

\*\*Experience:\*\* Beginner / Entry-level; personal, college, and hobby projects welcome

## About AI Xccelerate

AI Xccelerate is an enterprise AI execution and implementation company building its own agentic framework, AI Workers, and AI Agents. We build purpose-built solutions that connect AI, software, and physical devices to solve real business problems.

We’re looking for a curious, hands-on beginner who enjoys working with electronics, sensors, cameras, video, and software—and wants to use AI tools to turn ideas into working solutions.

## About the Role

You will help build solutions using ESP32 and similar hardware, sensors, cameras, and AI-powered software. Your projects will combine IoT, video processing, and AI vision with business applications and AIX’s AI-agent workflows.

This is a learning-oriented role. You do not need to be an expert in every area. We value practical projects, problem-solving, and the ability to learn quickly. You should be comfortable using AI coding tools while understanding, testing, and troubleshooting what you build.

## What You’ll Do

### Hardware and IoT

- Build and test prototypes using ESP32, ESP32-CAM, Arduino-compatible boards, Raspberry Pi, and similar hardware.

- Connect sensors for temperature, humidity, motion, distance, light, equipment status, and other business needs.

- Write and modify device software using Python, MicroPython, C/C++, or suitable tools.

- Connect devices to applications through Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, MQTT, and APIs.

- Assemble prototypes using breadboards, wiring, basic soldering, and enclosures.

### Cameras, Video, and AI Vision

- Set up cameras and capture images, video, and live streams.

- Help build AI-vision prototypes for tasks such as object detection, counting, presence detection, and visual inspection.

- Connect camera feeds to AI models or vision services running on suitable local hardware, servers, or cloud platforms.

- Combine camera observations with sensor readings to support business workflows.

- Test camera placement, lighting, image quality, detection accuracy, and response times.

- Help reduce false alerts and document situations where the system performs poorly.

- Follow project requirements for privacy, access control, and image or video retention.

### Software and AI Integration

- Use AI coding assistants to research components, write code, troubleshoot issues, and document solutions.

- Send sensor data and vision events to dashboards, databases, and business applications.

- Connect device and camera events to AIX’s AI Workers and AI Agents.

- Build alerts and approved automated actions based on sensor readings or visual events.

- Document wiring, components, code, setup instructions, and test results.

## Example Projects

| Business need | Example solution |

|---|---|

| Facility monitoring | Track temperature, humidity, and leaks, and send alerts when conditions require attention |

| Inventory visibility | Use cameras or sensors to detect item presence, count objects, or flag low stock |

| Visual inspection | Capture product images and help identify visible defects or missing components |

| Equipment monitoring | Combine sensor readings and camera observations to report equipment status |

| Operational monitoring | Detect activity or objects in defined areas and notify the appropriate team |

| AI-connected workflows | Have a sensor or vision event prompt an AIX AI Worker to log an issue, notify a team, or start an approved workflow |

## What We’re Looking For

- Basic hands-on experience with ESP32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, or similar hardware.

- At least one project you can demonstrate or clearly explain.

- Basic programming ability in Python, MicroPython, or C/C++.

- Familiarity with basic electronics, sensors, wiring, and GPIO.

- Interest in cameras, video processing, computer vision, and AI.

- Comfort using AI tools while checking their output through testing.

- Patience with debugging hardware, software, and connectivity issues.

- Ability to document your work and explain what works, what does not, and what you would improve.

A degree is not required. Personal projects, maker experience, college projects, and self-directed learning are welcome. You do not need prior experience training AI models.

## Nice to Have — Not Required

- Experience with ESP32-CAM, USB cameras, Raspberry Pi cameras, or IP cameras.

- Exposure to OpenCV, object-detection models such as YOLO, or AI vision APIs.

- Familiarity with video streams and tools such as RTSP or FFmpeg.

- Experience with MQTT, REST APIs, JSON, or Node-RED.

- Basic Git and GitHub skills.

- Experience creating a simple dashboard or connecting a device to a database.

- Basic soldering, multimeter use, or enclosure assembly skills.

- Interest in edge AI and running models locally.

## What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days

With guidance from the team:

- Build a working sensor-based prototype connected to a software application.

- Set up a camera and demonstrate a simple AI-vision use case.

- Connect a sensor or vision event to an AIX AI-agent workflow.

- Test practical issues such as Wi-Fi interruptions, poor lighting, missed detections, and false alerts.

- Document the solution so another team member can reproduce it.

- Contribute to a pilot that addresses a clear business need.

## What You’ll Gain

- Hands-on experience across hardware, IoT, video, AI vision, and software.

- Opportunities to build solutions for real business use cases.

- Exposure to AIX’s agentic framework, AI Workers, and AI Agents.

- Experience taking an idea from an early prototype to a tested business pilot.
